refusal_nudge_definitions.base_text: Your response above was stopped by a safety classifier — this is not a tool or API error. The rest of it was withheld, and tool calls in it that had not finished did not run. Do not produce that content again, even reworded.

refusal_nudge_definitions.interpretation: Qa increments U for started tool-use blocks that have no answered tool_result; when U is positive it uses wbo (the base nudge plus the Interrupted-result exception), otherwise it uses Ukr.
